title: A Novel Two-Parameter Penalty: Relaxation Degree Analysis and Sparse Signal Recovery
summary: In this article, we introduce a nonconvex two-parameter penalty function $P_{a,p}$, parameterized by $a\in(0,\infty)$ and $p\in(0,1]$, and the relaxation degree RD$_P$ for a separable nonconvex penalty function $P$. Based on $P_{a,p}$, we further propose the $P_{a,p}$ minimization framework for sparse signal recovery. This framework generalizes the TL1 minimization model established by S. Zhang and J. Xin (corresponding to the special case $p=1$) and provides a unified and flexible family of nonconvex penalty functions for sparse signal recovery. Using the sparse convex-combination…
